name: lighting
description: Your real logged-in browser and any app on your computer, as a few lines of text.
long_description: Lighting drives your open Brave, Chrome or Edge through a small extension and any desktop app through the accessibility APIs of Windows, macOS and Linux, with OCR as a fallback. Every action answers in one short line instead of a screenshot. Tasks that repeat become routines that run in one call. Nothing leaves your computer. Ask Claude to run `setup` once: it loads the browser extension by itself.

tools.name: lighting
tools.description: One lighting command line per call: open, snap, click, type, text, windows, snap w2, read (OCR), run <routine>, setup, help.
